articles.summary: For the past 3 years, Masco’s Flight Operations team has supported the Golightly Career & Technical Center’s Flight Training and Aviation Technology course for students in the Detroit Public Schools Community District. The course focuses on careers piloting either drones or airplanes, giving first-year students hours of hands-on training to be able to earn a FAA Remote Pilot Certificate, which allows them to fly drones for profit. Select students can return for a second year focused on passing the FAA Private Pilot Written Exam, the first required step to becoming a professional pilot. articles.title: Supporting Detroit’s Next Generation of Aviation Professionals

articles.summary: 2025 marks Masco’s eighth year of partnership with nonprofit Hire Heroes USA, which helps connect U.S. military members, veterans and their spouses to successful, rewarding career paths. In May, Masco had the honor of sponsoring the Military Spouse Award at the 3rd Annual Hire Heroes USA Empowerment Gala in Atlanta. This award recognizes a military spouse who has served as a silent hero for the military community with their selfless sacrifices and unwavering commitment. Congratulations to this year’s recipient, Verda Smith! Team members from our Georgia-based Hansgrohe Group had a great time celebrating at the event and presenting the award.…
articles.title: Hansgrohe Presents Hire Heroes USA Military Spouse Award
